name: Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic
description: Diagnostic breast-mass measurements with malignant and benign labels.
attribution: Wolberg, W., Mangasarian, O., Street, N., & Street, W. (1993). Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic).
normalization: Mapped M/B target codes to malignant/benign.

name: Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction
description: Questionnaire signs and symptoms for binary early-stage diabetes risk classification.
attribution: Islam, M. M. F., Ferdousi, R., Rahman, S., & Bushra, H. Y. Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction Dataset.
normalization: Normalized column names to lowercase snake_case.
Mapped target labels to lowercase without changing source rows.

name: Heart Disease — Cleveland
description: The documented Cleveland subset with a binary heart-disease presence target.
attribution: Janosi, A., Steinbrunn, W., Pfisterer, M., & Detrano, R. (1989). Heart Disease.
normalization: Assigned documented column names to the processed Cleveland file.
Mapped num=0 to absent and num=1..4 to present, following the UCI binary task description.

name: Chronic Kidney Disease
description: Mixed laboratory and categorical findings for CKD versus not-CKD classification.
attribution: Rubini, L., Soundarapandian, P., & Eswaran, P. (2015). Chronic Kidney Disease.
normalization: Normalized whitespace and official missing-value markers.
Expanded white/red blood cell count column names.
Normalized the negative class label to not_ckd.

name: ILPD Liver Patient Dataset
description: Biochemical markers and gender for binary liver-disease classification.
attribution: Ramana, B. & Venkateswarlu, N. (2022). ILPD (Indian Liver Patient Dataset).
normalization: Assigned documented column names to the source CSV.
Mapped Selector=1 to present and Selector=2 to absent.
Preserved missing feature values and source rows.
